34:
Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged.  And I know the brute who is doing it.  It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.

I won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now.  Ruined!  All ruined by that one menacing boar.  Put an end to that pest!  Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you.  He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
Martie Jainrose of Lakeshire wants you to kill Bellygrub.  Bring her his tusk as proof.
84: Here you go.  And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
Bring the Pork Belly Pie to Billy Maclure at the Maclure Vineyards.
134:
A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.

After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.

Please, {name}, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
184:
This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall.  It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna.  And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:

"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed.  Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.

The Furlbrows won't give us trouble.  Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."

You think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
Bring Furlbrow's Deed to Farmer Furlbrow.
234: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard.
284:
You thoroughly search this cluster of Murloc hovels, and find no trace of the Menethil Statuette.

Perhaps one of the two nearby hovels to the north and northeast will have more clues.
334:
My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter.  He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles.  I know a great {class} like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!

Please, {name}.  Can you take my son's sewing kit to him?  Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.
Go to the Larson Clothiers in the Stormwind Mage Quarter, and give Thurman Schneider his Sewing Kit.
434:
After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem.

While you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. I even dropped some false information.

Lescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. You need to kill them both before the guards return! When you're done, speak to Trias.
Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
484:
I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.

Met Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.

I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.

Being that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the waters right outside of town.
Obtain 4 Young Crocolisk Skins for James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.
584:
Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it.  But we are no closer to finding him.

We must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor know it.  They are the enemies of the Darkspear tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from their dead lips!

Bring me the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok the Dire and place them within this cauldron.

They are deep within Zul'Kunda.  Bring their heads...we will then make them talk.
Bring Gan'zulah's Head and Nezzliok's Head to the bubbling cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
634:
I ask of you one more small favor, {class}.  We await the reserves of Ironforge.  However, Roggo has knowledge of an Alliance camp to the north in Arathi Highlands at Refuge Pointe.

Travel there and seek out Captain Nials.  Ask the good Captain if the Alliance can spare some soldiers to help us reclaim Dun Modr and the Thandol Span.
Seek out Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
684:
A bounty has been placed on the head of Marez Cowl, a high-level advisor and operative of the Syndicate.  She was last seen within the Syndicate controlled territory of Stromgarde.

Bounty may be collected from Captain Nials.

Be warned: Marez is a skilled and cunning Warlock, known for her trafficking with demons.  Extreme caution is advised when hunting her.
Bring Marez's head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
734:
Wonderful, wonderful.

<Lotwil looks up at you for a moment before going back to his shackles.>

Go speak to Lucien, {name}. I need a cog #5. Bring it to me, will you?
Speak to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
784:
Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.

Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.
Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
834:
I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. Boss sent me to help the orcs here in Durotar. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?

The last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?

I gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.
Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.
884: When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.
Bring Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
934:
All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

However, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
984:
Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in Teldrassil, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... or worse.

I have seen a couple hints of corruption in Darkshore already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?
Find a corrupt furbolg camp in Darkshore and return to Terenthis in Auberdine.
1034:
Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness.  Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing.  But ... fever still rages within her.

Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust.  Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever.  Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.

The Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, {name}.  May Elune speed your journey.
Bring 5 Handfuls of Stardust to Pelturas in Astranaar.
1084:
It seems obvious to me that the protectors of the Vale--the treants--had something to do with the Venture Co. being driven back. Unfortunately, even those once great guardians have now become corrupt.

Gaxim thinks their corruption is somehow linked to the weapons the goblins used during their retreat.

I told him I'd collect a sample from a wounded treant and allow him to study it in order to figure out if that's true.

Bring me some of the shrapnel so the gnome can tell me more...
Bring a piece of Corroded Shrapnel to Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon.
1134:
We are not in open war with the Horde, but our peace is fragile.  We often find their agents moving against us, but they do so covertly.

One such advance was revealed to us from hidden sources in Theramore, claiming that the orcs collect venom from the pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the south.  Orc assassins then use the venom on their secret death raids against the Alliance!

If this is true, then we must stop them, {name}.  We must deny them their source of venom.
Bring 12 Pridewing Venom Sacs to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.
1184: Head back to Belgrom in Orgrimmar and tell him Moktar be doing his bidding well out in the Thousand Needles. Tell him also, that me studies progress, and I hope to be havin' learned more soon. That should please him greatly.
Return to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
1284: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
1384:
The Kolkar centaurs think their magic is strong.  They do not know magic!  They would not know magic if it bit them!

You will show them their magic is weak.  Go to the Kolkar  to the northeast and kill them.  Take their charms.  Bring me the charms and I will throw them in the fire and laugh!
Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 10 Crude Charms to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
1434:
A demon infestation does not occur without other influences--something else allows evil to gain a foothold.

It may start with a weakened spirit, a needless desire for power; perhaps it's a thirst for revenge, or the appeal for final justice. When we are beset by pain, evil takes advantage of us--evil such as the satyr.

Ties have been made between them and the Burning Blade, and Thrall would have them slain. Seek them out to the northeast of here, and return to me when you've driven them back.
Slay 7 Hatefury Rogues, 7 Hatefury Felsworn, 7 Hatefury Betrayers, and 7 Hatefury Hellcallers, and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
1484:
This creature is far more dangerous than I had anticipated.  No doubt Takata questions my abilities to take on such a creature, and it would insult his honor if he were not informed about what just happened.

Speak to the swordsman, tell him you are willing to slay the demon if he would allow it, but do not press too hard. It is better if he thinks it his own idea.
Speak to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
2284:
As sure as Malton is a dummy, those gems are still in Uldaman somewhere.  You're going to have to go back there and look for them.

Like I said before, if the information we have is correct then there's a ruby, a sapphire, and a topaz that go with the necklace.  Find them and put them in the necklace.

As to where the gems are, who knows?  Maybe you'll get lucky and find the corpse of the Paladin.  If he's not been stripped clean already, then maybe he's got them on him still.
Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.
2584:
When I first administered the elixir, {name}, I could tell that one or two applications would not satiate your appetite. Even now, I can see the hunger in your eyes. The concoction has addictive properties of which, seemingly, the most strong of will cannot resist.

So be it! Should you require more of the lung juice cocktail, venture back into the wasteland and find for me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain.
Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one Basilisk Brain to Bloodmage Drazial.$B
2784: Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
2934:
I must have a fresh sample of the venom you brought me.  The spiders from which it was gathered must dwell in the Hinterlands -- hunt them until you find an undamaged venom sac and bring it to me.  You will find many spiders near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.

Do not tarry, {name}, for the venom sac must be fresh when you deliver it.
Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
3784:
Excuse me {class}, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project.  While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.

Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
3884: You have uncovered a mangled journal.  Parts of it remain legible, with a Williden Marshal claiming ownership over the contents therein.  If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the northern part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought higher ground from the savage beasts of the Crater once their base camps were overrun.
Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
4084:
I do not know the one you speak of, {name}.

But worry not; if your friend was on a journey to find me, I do know what it was he desired.

In the heart of Un'Goro Crater dwells evil of the purest form. This evil takes the shape of an elemental called Blazerunner... protected by an aura that none can dispel...

None... except those with enough power to do so. I can teach you of this power, {name}.

First, do as I ask. Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart from the creatures in Felwood, then return.
Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.
4134:
It is rumored that the Dark Iron Hurley Blackbreath has stolen a recipe for ale.  This ale, Thunderbrew Lager, is said to infuse its imbiber with great strength and courage.  We wish to study the drink.  Perhaps, we will find other applications for its virtues... applications more in line with Forsaken objectives.

Delve into Blackrock Depths, find Hurley, take from him the recipe for Thunderbrew lager and bring it to me.

And to find him, you may have to entice him by threatening his precious ale.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
4184:
This is grim news, {name}. To discover that our mortal enemies are merely pawns of a much greater threat is disheartening. There is no possible way that Lakeshire could survive an attack from both the Blackrock orcs and the black dragonflight. Should Lakeshire fall to this menace, Darkshire would fall next, and then what? Goldshire? Stormwind itself?

You must take this information to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind at once! If this does not merit the aid of Stormwind, nothing will and all is lost.
Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.$B$BBolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.
4284:
I'm sure you've noticed 'em, {name}. They're everywhere!

What am I talking about? Why, the crystals, of course!

The crystals... They're all over the crater. Most people ignore them, but I have a strange feeling that they hold power within them. I've been doing experiments here with them for a while, but I can't seem to find anything. Well, I haven't yet, anyway.

Say, I'm running a little low on the crystals I have here -- think you might be able to collect some more for me?
Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.
4384:
The Pylon table allows you to combine red power crystals with blue power crystals.

According to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to weaken an enemy's defenses.
4484: Do not waste my time, {race}. Give me what I require. Thirty gold and the components.
4734:
{name}, I've been working hard on a new device, the eggscilloscope!  It's designed to project a burst of cold energy at the egg of a black dragon... and freeze it solid!  Can you test it for me?

I heard that high up in Blackrock Spire, the dragons have a rookery where they hatch their eggs.  That's where you'll have to go to test the eggscilloscope, and then let me know how it worked!

And don't worry.  Frozen dragon eggs should be harmless.  It's the unfrozen ones you have to worry about!
Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.
4984:
While there was little I could do alone to thwart the Scourge, I nevertheless came to these lands to try and heal the damage done to nature.  Animals suffer from the plague that continues to choke these lands, unable to find mercy and peace.  I ask for you to continue what I could not finish here.

There is no salvation for the suffering animals but a sweet and merciful release.  Seek out diseased wolves nearby and put them down.  Please {name}, end their misery - doing so will surely soothe mine.
Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.$B$B
5084:
This greenish liquid... it reminds me a bit of the sludge I saw when traveling through Felwood. And I have seen some Winterfall Runners passing into Timbermaw... Perhaps these things have something to do with the flask you found, {name}.

There is a large group of furbolg just past Timbermaw Hold, in Felwood. Called the Deadwood tribe, they have been corrupted and driven mad by the fel. Why don't you look around there and see if you can find any evidence of dealings between the Winterfall and the Deadwood?
Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
5234:
You delicately top off the empty bottle; a sample of the foul substance that churns under the platform of the cauldron now oozes back and forth inside the fragile glass container.

With the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
5384:
This is it, {name}.

<Eva points to the vial inside the bag.>

The blood of innocents. The purest blood, used to appease Krastinov's master.

It is with this blood that Kirtonos may be summoned. It is with this blood, then, that Kirtonos must be destroyed.

Take the blood to the porch. Place it upon the brazier. Kirtonos will come - he cannot resist. When he appears, unleash the fury and wrath of a thousand innocent deaths upon him.

Should you succeed, you will earn more than just our gratitude.

Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.$B$BFight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.$B
5534:
What?! What?!

That wasn't good enough for you? You know how expensive those explosives are? They sell for... oh, nevermind. Fine, you want to make some real money? Cause that's how business is done: you prove you're a valuable employee and then you're rewarded adequately after you stick it out some.

If you're a "valuable" employee, then hit the Ruins of Eldarath and find me some rune that them Blood elves were lookin' for. The naga apparently have it in their possession.
Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.
5884:
A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption.  My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve.

When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon.  In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve.
6134:
There's a valley to the southeast, the Valley of Bones, haunted by centaur ghosts.  Sounds scary, doesn't it?  Well think how scary it is to the centaur!

Here, take this crate of ghost magnets.  If you place one between the two big skeletons in the valley, the Dead Goliaths, then ghosts will wander to it.  Distance yourself, take out the ghosts and get their ghost-o-plasm.

I have a sneaking suspicion the Magram are VERY interested in this gunk. I plan to sell it to 'em.
Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.
6184:
The only information we have thus far, then, is that Nathanos Marris may have been slain by this Blightcaller. We assume the Blightcaller is the same fiend that disposed of my agents.

Flint Shadowmore, another SI:7 operative, is stationed at the Alliance encampment of Chillwind Point in the Western Plaguelands. Seek him out; he will debrief you on the current situation in the Plagues and give you an assignment.

Good luck, {name}.
Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.$B
6284:
Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.

Besseleth and her eight-legged children of the forest have claimed this canyon as their webbed lair.

Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat has placed a bounty on Besseleth. Slay her and bring proof of your killing to Maggran; there you will receive your reward for disposing this eight-legged menace.
Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.
6384:
For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to Orgrimmar.  When you get there, you can take Zargh's Meats to Gryshka.  Her inn is in the Valley of Strength, not far from the Skytower, where my wind rider will drop you off.

Speak with me again when you are ready for the journey.
Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.
6584:
The time watchers, children of Nozdormu - Lord of the Centuriesss...

It is three that guard the Caverns of Time, but only one that holds the interests of the Black Flight: The Time Shifter, Chronalis, favored drakeling of Nozdormu.

Ssstrike at this champion, a blow to make even the stoic sands of time weep. Return to me with his skull.
Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.
7484:
This libram almost aroused interest in one of the younger Lorekeeper's familiars. Poor thing, it was only a few weeks old.

Those among you who are more magically inclined might find this item interesting.

The Libram of Focus was lost in this wing. I can only assume one of the Highborne spirits holds it in their possession.

Bring the Libram along with some large brilliant shards, skin of shadow, and a pristine black diamond and I shall conjure the Arcanum.
Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.
7734:
I have a lead on an even BETTER source of hides, if that's even possible to believe!  In the northern parts of Feralas - deep within Rage Scar Hold - are another throng of yetis.  They're much tougher than the ones you dealt with before, so if you're up for a bigger challenge you'd best be on your toes!

I would reward you handsomely for a stack of ten of their hides; bring them to me here, and we'll finish our business.
Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
7784: Seek out High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength.
Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.
7834:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
8184:
Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components.

The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord.

The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles.

Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
Bring me thise things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you! $BPrimal Hakkari Idol$BPunctured Voodoo Doll
8284:
A camp of Twilight's Hammer cultists once thrived northwest of here.  If you were to venture there now, you'd find the area swarming with elementals and nothing but scattered pieces of wood and canvas to mark the spot where the camp was.

I've recovered a few fragments of a clay tablet from the site, but I have too few of them to piece together anything useful.  See if you can find the remaining tablet fragments so we can shed some light into the Twilight's Hammer presence here in Silithus.
Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.
8384: The war against the Horde is quickly depleting our supplies, {name}.  It is vital to maintain control of Arathi Basin to keep the stream of resources flowing!  Have you lent a hand in Arathi yet?
Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
8434: The battle in Warsong Gulch rages on, {name}.  Do your part to drive the Silverwing Sentinels out of our lands!
Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8484:
Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, {name}.  If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.

Please - take this offering to the dwarven king that resides in a mountain of iron; I believe you call this city Ironforge.  In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Alliance.  It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Alliance's efforts in brokering peace.
Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
8534: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence.  Scout Azenel has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Zora for several days now.  Find her and obtain a written report.  We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, {name}.

Contact Cenarion Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora and return the Hive'Zora Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
8584:
If there is one thing that you should know about me, it is this: NEVER ask me about my business! I work with things you simply cannot understand. Like for example: Do you know what a psychotronic muzzledorf is? Of course you don't! And that's why we leave the planning to me and the fetching to you.

As I said earlier, if this is going to work, we're going to need a 500 pound chicken.

Head to Gadgetzan and speak with Dirge Quickcleave - he'll get you started on finding a suitable specimen.
Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.
8634:
Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.

Bring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.

You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
8734:
Tyrande will be notifed, mortal. Shan'do Stormrage has prepared me for this contingency.

Now you must venture to the Moonglade and speak with Remulos. He will have further instruction as to the summoning of Eranikus.

We all wish you great luck.
Travel to the Moonglade and speak to Keeper Remulos.
8784: You have discovered an ancient Qiraji artifact! Perhaps one of the dragons near the entrance of the temple would have a use for this relic.
Take the Ancient Qiraji Artifact to the dragons hiding near the entrance of the temple.$B
8934: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
Bring a Devout Belt and a set of Devout Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
9034: During your battles with the Scourge in Naxxramas, should you come across desecrated battlements and wartorn plate scraps, return them to me and I shall craft for you a piece of armor worn by heroes.

Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreadnaught Breastplate if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Breastplate, 25 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals.$B
9084:
If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.

Enter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.

Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Bracers if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bracers, 6 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar, 2 Cured Rugged Hides and 10 gold pieces.
9184:
The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.

Work Order LW-971:

10 Wicked Leather Headbands.

All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
Deliver 10 Wicked Leather Headbands and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Headband - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.$B
9234: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Icebane gauntlets. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 2 Essences of Water and 200 gold.
78684:
What? Where am I? How... how did I get here?

<The man before you stumbles around as if sea sick. His eyes widen and his hands tremble and you stare at each other in a moment of shared confusion.>

Ah... A fellow warlock I see. Perhaps we discuss what led to this series of events and maybe we can find out what went wrong?

<Unsure of what to do next, you suggest they return to speak with Doan Karhan.>
79984: Wirdal? Yeah I know him. He's a gnome, but I won't hold that against him as a fellow transpolyportion enthusiast like myself.  He took off outta here a few months back for somewhere in Kalimdor, but he 'ports in every now and then to grab supplies. I could probably transpolyport you to him, but you'd need his coordinates or I'd probably just teleport you into a mountain or something. If you can find his quadrangulation beacons in Kalimdor and attuned to them, that would do the trick!
80134:
As long as you have the transponder in your possession, all you need to do is step on the pad and you'll be teleported to Gnomeregan.

You may experience some unusual side effects, but none of those should be permanent... anymore.

I almost forgot the most important part - getting back. When you're ready to come back, just step on the transpolyporter pad in Gnomeregan!

Now to calibrate the transponder to your size and weight.
81734: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Rotting Orchard. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Dorilar there and return to me.
81784: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Doran Dreambough there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.
81834: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane and collect Starsilver Ore from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a miner.
83934: Heya! You look like the "resourceful adventurer" type so maybe you can help me out. See, my brothers and I came from Kezan looking to start up a new business venture but we ran afoul of some pirates who stole our startup money. The people who are funding our operation back home aren't exactly what I'd call understanding, so we'd make it worth your while if are able to find any of the coin and return it. It's no ordinary gold but you should know it when you see it.
84184:
Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.

I, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
84384:
De loa have told me of a poison gatherin' strength in Ashenvale, on the tainted land where the great demon Mannoroth was slain. Someone be drawin' power from the pit lord's remains.

They must be usin' illusions to hide their rituals. If you are to stop them, you'll be needin' protectin from their deceptions.

My tribe uses an extract from owlbeast glands in an enchantment to discern truth from lies. Collect these glands from the owlbeasts in Winterspring.
85634:
The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence.  A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered.  We would not be here today without them.

Bring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors.  Embrace the madness!
86434:
I've come to this timeline in search of a dangerous agent of the void. This creature has wreaked havoc across their own timeline and I fear that they will do the same here. I've followed a trail of voidstuff to this place but the trail has gone cold, which is why I'd like to enlist your aid.

Nearby, there is a camp of Twilight's Hammer cultists. This creature has a way of influencing susceptible minds, so keep an eye out for anything that would be out of place, even for deranged cultist types.
86784:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
88884:
Just south of here, along the beach, there are some tablets of highborne writing. They document the highborne's investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane. 

The tablets are being kept in pagoda-like structures, guarded by naga, so I wouldn't dare attempt to procure them myself.

Fortunately, I've found myself a new assistant! 

So, what do you say? Think you could be of further use in the pursuit of knowledge?
89234:
What we spoke about at Light's Hope and my history with Caldoran... It all started right here at Stratholme. You are familiar with the "culling" of Stratholme that occurred early on in the Third War, yes?

Well, I was here, and so was Caldoran. This is where our history begins. If you would be willing, meet me just outside of Stratholme's service entrance to the east.
91734:
<The Forsaken sways unsteadily> 

'ey! <hic> Do me a favor ... would ya? 

Go to uh ... Azshara 'n ... tell <hic> Jediga ...

Expectin' a ... 'mportant deliv'ry <hic>
92434:
Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.

Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
92684:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92834:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
93034:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, {name}. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
93584:
The lands surrounding the Well of Eternity are overrun with followers of the Wild King. Many once stood beside us, bound by the same oaths, but their devotion has curdled into reckless zeal. They actively hinder our efforts to tend Nordrassil and protect the Well.

I will not pretend this is easy, nor that my hands will be clean. Still, we cannot allow them to harm our land or strike our flank when the greater incursion begins.

Thin their ranks swiftly, and may Elune forgive what necessity demands.
93684:
While I know of no other settlement like ours, I have seen lost ones south of here in the Blasted Lands. They are much like the ones of Fallow Sanctuary--hostile and mindless. I assumed that was the fate which befell all of our kind there.

However, if Onku's vision points to a lone draenei wandering a wasteland, then perhaps I was wrong.

I am calling on you once again, {name}. Find this draenei and aid them however you can.
93834:
Burrow beetles! They're a bane... and now they dig in our den more than their own. We beat them back and swing clubs when we see them skulk by, but they are quick, and to hide in the dark is their shield.

If you spot them as you climb our den, squash them! We will take their crushed shells and make a meal, so it is not all bad.
94234: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Shadow Goggles, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94284: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Catseye Ultra Goggles, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94334: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Masterwork Target Dummy, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94484:
A moment if you will, {name}. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94734:
Gobam know Chub'chob pet love to eat food. Specially good food!

Yum yum berry and plant from river make good treat for Snufflesnout. Berry sweet. Best berry from human farm near ocean.

You find. Bring back. Me help make big treat.
94884:
I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos.

I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest.
94984:
No matter our efforts, the Twilight forces persist. We've deduced they must be coming from somewhere else.

With the new pet you brought me, I was able to politely ask our dear Twilight Thrall if it knew anything about where its former masters were coming from. Of note was mention of shadow magics and an ogre by the name of Nar'gurk in a hidden stronghold north of Sunnyglade.

Seek him out. Kill him and recover what you can. There must be something we can learn from these efforts.
95184:
The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran.

I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death.

If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there.
95284:
A small force of Kor'kron soldiers passed through here a few days ago. Never told me why they were here, and I didn't ask. They bought supplies, took a bit of rest, then moved on.

The Kor'kron are the elite of the elite and tougher than elekk hooves, but I can't help feeling that something went wrong.

I did overhear one of them mention "the island", and there's an island called Alcaz just off the coast. It's a really nasty place. Get some friends and look into what befell these Kor'kron.
95384: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>
95534:
<The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>

Rumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.

There's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.

< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >
95884:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95934:
My surveying tools show signs of a never-before-seen mineral in these caves. Cubic draconia, I call it. Probably worth a fortune.

Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts.

I'm sure there's a few crystals poking up from the dirt in there. If you're willing to dodge a few dragons and get one, you'd really be helpin' a gal out.
95984:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one's especially large. The leader of the nearby pride, most likely.

If rumor spreads about a man-eating lion prowling around on my watch, Demar will be furious. Fortunately, I have a plan.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. We can use that to lure the beast out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound. There's tallstriders all over the plains. Get me a beak, and make it snappy!
96084:
I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water.

I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.
96334:
Most of the humans we fought wore blood red bandanas. I seem to recall hearing of a criminal organization operating in the Eastern Kingdoms known as 'The Defias Brotherhood' who are known for their red masks. Why they are active here in Kalimdor I don't know, but kill any that cross your path and bring their masks to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. 

He'll be able to determine if these are in fact Defias masks.
96984:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
97234:
Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.
97284:
If Malem is still alive, then I suspect the Burning Blade orcs are expecting someone to come searching for her soon enough. They will certainly be ready for a fight.

I would prefer if you kept a low profile and stayed out of their way, but the far more likely reality is that they will be looking to meet you, blade to Burning Blade, at every opportunity.

So how about we plan to keep score from the start. Kill as many as you can, and I'll make it worth your time.
97534:
Pssst, wanna know somethin'? It's easier to make profit in a place like this than you think... it's all about knowing how to market! I've seen what these tech-heads do when they get their hands on something they think they can turn into a fuel cell.

Even better if it's still glowin' or sputtering steam.

Why don't we strike a deal? Bring back some of the parts that fall off their machines in the desert, and I'll kick you back a share of the coin I get from selling the salvage back to the junkers!
97884:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied {race}. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.
99034:
The Lich called Ras Frostwhisper resides on the isle of Caer Darrow, in the Cult of the Damned training grounds known as the Scholomance. This creature has a number of alchemical components of some value, including a sample of Everfrost taken from the Frozen Throne itself.

I need you to retrieve it for me.

Oh, and while you are there, I also want you to dispose of the headmaster of the school, Gandling. Bring me his signet as proof.
99134:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--{name}, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99234:
There must be more to the Maul than this!

Perhaps the loud Spectator who oversees the event at Dire Maul will know!
